sources.title: Arrow 2 Telos model reference
sources.evidence: Exact-model documentation: generally available hosted arrow-2-telos, text/image/SVG input, SVG output, 1,050,000 context and 65,536 output. SVG generation, vectorization, editing and animation depend on operation authority; Responses is available when open_responses is advertised for the key.

sources.title: Arrow model comparison
sources.evidence: Direct comparison names Telos separately from Arrow 2 and confirms 1,050,000 versus 131,072 context. It publishes capabilities and limits but no parameter-count or topology table.

sources.title: Arrow 2 Telos product model page
sources.evidence: Names this exact Arrow-family model, up to 14 reference images, and five operations. Says it combines Arrow intelligence with frontier-model capabilities, without identifying the component models or neural architecture.

sources.title: Introducing Arrow 2 and Arrow 2 Telos
sources.evidence: Dated September 7, 2026. Introduces both variants, describes Telos refinement using frontier models, and says Arrow 2 is available now. The date precedes the September 16 public app/API launch record; it does not explicitly establish a separate Telos availability date.

sources.title: QuiverAI changelog
sources.evidence: September 16, 2026 API entry names both Arrow 2 and Telos with token billing and announces the Responses interface for caller-executed function/custom tools. The app entry is also September 16. Later October 6 and September 29 changes concern data controls/headers, not a new Telos model or technical disclosure.

sources.title: Arrow 2 app and API launch announcement
sources.evidence: Official business account tweet, retrieved through X syndication, created 2026-09-16T18:45:56Z: announces the latest Arrow 2 models available in App and API. The short text does not name Telos separately. Direct X page returned 403; the official syndication payload was accessed.

sources.title: Text to SVG model guide
sources.evidence: Explicitly recommends arrow-2-telos for detailed SVG work, supports text prompts and up to 14 reference images, and documents reasoning/draft/content stream events. Telos rejects native sampling overrides; these restrictions differ from Responses.

sources.title: Migrate to the Responses API
sources.evidence: For models advertising open_responses, callers declare functions/custom tools; Arrow selects calls and callers execute/replay results. Native output is SVG source in data[].svg; Responses returns calls or text messages. Opaque reasoning IDs are replayed, not private reasoning text. Hosted tools and stateful response continuation are unsupported.

sources.title: Create OpenResponse API reference
sources.evidence: Current endpoint specifically names Arrow 2 and Telos sampling behavior. Supports reasoning effort and caller-defined tools. Full schema enumerates response item types, but broader schema possibilities are not treated as proof of hosted-tool support; the migration guide defines current deployed restrictions.

sources.title: QuiverAI Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Section 6 reserves the service rights to QuiverAI and third-party licensors subject to limited service licenses. Section 8.2 separately addresses generated user content. This supports Proprietary hosted-service classification, not an open-weight model license.

sources.title: QuiverAI company and research announcement
sources.evidence: February 25 article explains SVG as visual code generation and identifies founders' preceding StarVector and RLRF research. It concerns Arrow 1.0, not Telos, and does not bind a checkpoint size or architecture to the later model.

sources.title: StarVector research project and comparison table
sources.publisher: StarVector research authors including QuiverAI cofounder
sources.evidence: Reviewed model architecture and table: image encoder plus adapter and language decoder for StarVector 1B/8B, with separate released checkpoints. Neither Arrow 2 nor Telos is named; research ancestry does not establish the later production model's topology or count.

sources.title: Rendering-Aware Reinforcement Learning research
sources.publisher: RLRF research authors including QuiverAI cofounders
sources.evidence: Reviewed training method and full comparison table, covering StarVector-1B and Qwen2.5-VL 3B/7B experiments plus comparison models. No Arrow 2 Telos row or parameter disclosure; these experiment counts are not transferred.

sources.title: Official QuiverAI public repository inventory
sources.evidence: Accessed complete six-repository inventory: SDK, OpenAPI, provider and agent-plugin repositories. No Telos weights/configuration or model training implementation is published there. The official blog index and later updates were also checked; no exact Telos technical/interpretability report was recovered.

sources.title: Authenticated live model metadata endpoint
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated read returned HTTP 401. No inference call was made and live key-specific availability was not verified; published first-party documentation supplies the audited specifications.

sources.title: Original Models.dev catalog record
sources.evidence: Frozen source lead lists September 16 and text/image output, reasoning and tools. It is not used as verification; first-party evidence supplies the supported context and capabilities.

name.note: Exact first-party model name and arrow-2-telos identifier.

developer.note: QuiverAI supplies this named model service; undisclosed frontier components are not separately identified developers.

family.note: Normalized lowercase Arrow family; Telos remains a distinct named variant.

release_date.note: Month precision. September 7 blog introduces both variants, while September 16 official changelog and business-account launch announce public app/API availability. The earlier blog explicitly says Arrow 2 available but does not distinguish exact Telos availability; primary dates do not securely resolve its earliest release day.

open_weights.note: Published through the proprietary hosted service; reviewed official distribution documentation and public repositories provide no released Telos weights.

license.note: Descriptive service/model classification under retained intellectual-property rights. Output ownership and open-source client SDK licenses do not license model weights.

parameters_b.note: No exact Telos total is disclosed in the accessed model pages, comparison table, release, preceding research or current public repository inventory. Searched later technical/training/interpretability material without recovering an exact-model disclosure. StarVector/Qwen experiment sizes cannot be borrowed; unnamed frontier components preclude a complete-system total.

active_parameters_b.note: No activated-per-token count, routing configuration or defined component accounting for Telos is published in the reviewed evidence.

architecture.note: Visual code generation and combination with frontier-model refinement are product descriptions, not a neural topology. The older StarVector VLM architecture and RLRF experiment backbones are not established Telos components. No dense/MoE/Transformer label is inferred.

context_window.note: Exact first-party Telos limit, distinct from Arrow 2 131,072 and the 65,536 output limit. This is a documented service/model limit, not a native training-length claim or a verified live key-specific deployment.

modalities.note: Inputs include text and reference images; SVG markup is text and can also be accepted as an image-format reference by supported endpoints. Output is serialized editable SVG source or Responses text/tool arguments. Clear image output to avoid classifying rendered vector markup as native raster/image generation; SVG animations are code, not native video output.

reasoning.note: Native SVG streaming documents reasoning events for Telos-capable generation; Responses supports reasoning configuration/history. This does not expose private chain-of-thought or identify the undisclosed component performing refinement.

tool_call.note: Supported through Responses when the key/model catalog enables open_responses: the model selects caller-declared function/custom tools, and the caller executes them. Native SVG endpoints and the separate MCP integration do not themselves establish this capability; hosted tools remain unsupported.

description.value: QuiverAI model that generates and refines editable SVG code from text, images and source SVGs.
description.note: Factual inputs/output and editing behavior replace the unqualified high-fidelity promotional wording.

patch.description: QuiverAI model that generates and refines editable SVG code from text, images and source SVGs.

sources.label: Arrow 2 app and API launch announcement

patch.notes: Release month is verified as September 2026; the September 7 blog and September 16 app/API launch records leave the earliest Telos release day unresolved. The published context limit is 1,050,000 tokens, with a separate 65,536-token output limit. Outputs are editable SVG source code, including coded animations, not native raster images or video. Reasoning is documented; caller-executed function/custom tools require a key/model catalog that enables Responses. Parameter counts and neural architecture remain undisclosed: the developer describes frontier-model refinement without identifying its components, and earlier StarVector/RLRF research does not establish Telos specifications. No live inference or authenticated model-catalog request was performed.

summary: Audited all14 fields. Adds Arrow family and Proprietary license, corrects output to SVG text/code and release to September month precision because primary dates differ. Confirms exact1,050,000 context, input images, reasoning and conditional caller-executed tools. Total/active parameters and neural architecture remain undisclosed after exact-model docs, comparison tables, official inventory and founders' research review; no sibling or experiment specifications transferred.
